text:
Which statements describe properties of transition elements?
1
They form coloured compounds.
2
They have variable oxidation states.
3
They have low densities.
4
They are volatile.
A
1 and 2
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
3 and 4
subject: Chemistry
